title: Search Slack with AI: track down a specific message
h1: find the slack message behind a question
description: Search Slack by phrase, person, channel or date with a bot. Get a focused set of matches and understand why a search hit is only part of a thread.
keywords: ai slack message search by date
answer: **find the promise before you walk into the supplier call.** give the bot a phrase, person, slack channel or date. it searches by relevance or time and gathers more results when needed. use the match to open the thread: a later reply may have changed the deal. searching leaves slack alone.
og_line: a focused search beats a remembered phrase.
what:
**start with the phrase you half remember.** add the channel, person or month if you know them. the bot returns matching wording with its author and time. ask for oldest first to trace the first mention.

then read the conversation. search and thread reading are separate actions, and later replies can turn a promising offer into a rejected one.
uses: find the first proposal for a supplier discount
locate the missing-adapter message in the equipment channel
collect mentions of the old product name before a rename
trace a delivery promise inside a known date window

routine.message: each wednesday at 14:35, search #vendor-terms for freight surcharges mentioned in the previous seven days. show the matches oldest first here, with author, date and exact relevant words. read matching threads separately when replies could change the meaning. report failed reads. never post a reply or call a proposed price an agreed one.
routine.needs: slack with read only for message search and thread reading
routine.output:
freight surcharge discussion
- ren, hollow pine supply, monday: proposed a winter surcharge
- leonie, tuesday: asked whether it covers returns
replies returned: still discussing it; no agreement found.

steps: connect slack and give the search bot read only.
give a phrase plus a channel or person. see whether the first matches fit.
choose relevance or date order. ask for more results if the first batch leaves gaps.
schedule the recurring search and read its next runs on the routine card.
watch: **the first batch may be incomplete.** ask for all matches when the count matters.
**connect the account that can see the conversation.** search cannot reveal private messages outside its access.
**a sleeping laptop cannot start the search.** leave dusk running on an awake machine or use dusk cloud.

faq.q: can i search only messages from one person?
faq.a: **yes.** name the person and the bot can narrow by sender. it can also narrow by channel and dates.

faq.q: can it find the oldest mention instead of the best match?
faq.a: **yes, ask for oldest first.** sorting by relevance can put a newer message at the top.

faq.q: does searching slack tell me whether the question was answered?
faq.a: **follow the match into its thread.** the replies tell you whether anyone answered the question.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

steps: connect slack with read only access
ask for one phrase in a named channel during the last week
open the matching thread before treating the message as an answer

mistakes.mistake: quoting the proposal as the final price
mistakes.fix: read the replies. later messages may change or reject it.

mistakes.mistake: asking for the oldest mention but accepting relevance order
mistakes.fix: say "oldest first" and compare the dates.

tip.text: the reply that changes everything is often one message below the search hit.

worked.intro: an invented example, with made-up names.
worked.before:
in #vendor-terms, falk proposes a freight surcharge.
a search for "surcharge" finds that message.
worked.after:
search result: falk proposed a surcharge.
later reply: rejected.
the returned conversation contains no agreed surcharge.
